title: Fortune Chakki Fresh Atta, 1kg
aplus_content: Every grain tells a story, and this one’s a bestseller. Carefully selected native varieties blend to perfection for unmatched quality. Expect rotis that are not just wholesome but bursting with natural flavour.

These grains are the overachievers of the field! Designed to soak in just the right amount of water, they transform your rotis into soft, fluffy delights that stay fresh longer. Think of them as the warm hug from nature you have been waiting for.

Say goodbye to dough dilemmas! Because this flour practically kneads itself. Silky-smooth and ready to go, it saves you from the trouble while making dough-making a joy. Perfect for those who believe great rotis shouldn’t come with an arm workout.
There’s magic in the old ways, and this flour is proof. Slow-ground in a traditional chakki, it’s rich in texture, flavour, and nostalgia. It's like taking you back to the goodness of simpler days.

title: Britannia Gobbles Bar Cake Fruity Fun, 110 g
description: Indulge in the delightful Britannia Fruit Cake, boasting soft, flavorful slices enriched with luscious fruit bits, milk, and eggs. Experience the exquisite blend of all-natural goodness that melts effortlessly in every bite, reflecting Britannia's commitment to crafting fresh and wholesome cakes adored across India. Believing in delivering fresh and healthy products, Britannia India manufactures some of India's favourite cakes.
